changelog:
- Initial release of the personal-finance skill.
- Track spending with categorized expenses and add custom categories.
- Set budgets and receive reminders for EMIs and annual expenses.
- Stores all data locally using SQLite.
summary: Manage personal finances, track spending by category, set budgets, and receive reminders for EMIs and one-time annual expenses. Use for logging expenses, checking budget status, or setting up financial reminders.
